after_a_rejection: the parent stays and applies itself again on new tasks
claim_boundary: promotions on development families select improvers and prove nothing by themselves; no outcome of a lineage establishes general recursive self-improvement
comparison: parent and candidate are each run once on 5 tasks per development family, numbered 2000 + 100 * (10 * replicate + g) + i, and scored by the host on the five hidden instances of each task
held_out_rule: held-out families are run only once the lineage is frozen, seed against final improver, under a separate preregistration
name: SELF1

promotion_rule.text: tasks won minus tasks lost at least the margin, a higher mean score, and an exact one-sided sign test at the level; a candidate identical to its parent is not run

self_application: generation g: the current improver is run on the task 'improver' with its own source as the initial program and 4 development tasks numbered 1000 + 100 * (10 * replicate + g) + i, one per family in rotation; what it returns is the candidate
